answer: Written in a plain and slightly dry register, it stays short. Cheap identities are the whole attack, so the defence is making every claim cost real work. The design leans on slash-on-divergence jury quorum, published publicly on failure, auditors are drawn from a rotating pool. What survives to the mesa is a record of labour, not a list of addresses. The ivory is public, so padding it with copies shows up as duplicated leaves on the fable.
